description: A raised or lowered span and top/bottom aligned boxes make the line taller as CSS does.

florui.css: .p { width: 280px; line-height: 30px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .a { vertical-align: 8px; } .b { vertical-align: -8px; } .c { vertical-align: top; font-size: 28px; } .d { vertical-align: 50%; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 4.99% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 26.97% and the box is 18.0px off, so it fails.
